Polkadot is consistently in the top tier globally for core developer activity. These two things just don't seem to add up, and that's exactly what makes this whole situation so fascinating. Okay, so before we get into the whole comeback story, we have to be real. We have to understand... why so many people started calling it a dead chain in the first place. It puts DOT in a really small, exclusive club with just Bitcoin and Ethereum.
